DB.description: Cloudflare D1 database for task state, subscriptions, and articles.

RAW_BUCKET.description: Cloudflare R2 bucket for raw/refined transcript checkpoints and uploaded audio.

PROCESSING_WORKFLOW.description: Cloudflare Workflows durable execution engine for the transcription and refinement pipeline.

CONTROL_AUTH_USER.description: Username for Basic Auth on `/manage` and the control APIs. **Required** — without it the control plane refuses every request on workers.dev.

CONTROL_AUTH_PASSWORD.description: Password for that Basic Auth user. Use a long random value, e.g. `openssl rand -base64 24`.

REFINER_API_KEY.description: API key for your OpenAI-compatible LLM (OpenAI, DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Qwen, …). Set the API base URL and model later in **Settings → Advanced** at `/manage`.

GITHUB_TOKEN.description: Fine-grained GitHub token with **Contents: Read and write** on your manuscript repository only. [Create one](https://github.com/settings/personal-access-tokens/new).

GITHUB_OWNER.description: GitHub user or organization that owns the manuscript repository (create an empty repository first).

GITHUB_REPO.description: Name of the GitHub repository where manuscripts are saved as Markdown.

GITHUB_BRANCH.description: Branch of the manuscript repository (default `main`). Values typed on the deploy page are not saved for variables — to change it, edit `wrangler.jsonc` in your new repository.

GITHUB_PODCAST_PATH.description: Folder for manuscript Markdown files in the repository (default `podcasts/transcripts`). Values typed on the deploy page are not saved for variables — to change it, edit `wrangler.jsonc` in your new repository.

TRANSCRIPTION_PROVIDER.description: `self-hosted` (your own Transcription Service, see docs) or `dashscope` (Alibaba Cloud Paraformer — no server to run; also set DASHSCOPE_API_KEY).

TRANSCRIPTION_SERVICE_URL.description: URL of your self-hosted Transcription Service. Leave the placeholder if you use `dashscope`.

CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_ID.description: Cloudflare Access Service Token Client ID for the transcription service hostname. Optional; add after deploying if your Transcription Service sits behind Cloudflare Access.

CF_ACCESS_CLIENT_SECRET.description: Cloudflare Access Service Token Client Secret for the transcription service hostname. Optional; add after deploying if your Transcription Service sits behind Cloudflare Access.

DASHSCOPE_API_KEY.description: Alibaba Cloud DashScope API key, used only when TRANSCRIPTION_PROVIDER is `dashscope`. Leave the placeholder otherwise.

R2_ACCOUNT_ID.description: Cloudflare account ID for presigning custom audio upload URLs (optional).

R2_ACCESS_KEY_ID.description: R2 Access Key ID for presigning custom audio upload URLs (optional).

R2_SECRET_ACCESS_KEY.description: R2 Secret Access Key for presigning custom audio upload URLs (optional).

R2_BUCKET_NAME.description: Leave as is — the deploy script sets it to the R2 bucket chosen above.
